dct_description_sm: Ayyildiz Pazari Ankara Caddesi No 149 ; Bon Matbaasi.
Flag illustrations of European countries in margins.
Shows land routes, major waterways, cities.
Shows Europe, with parts of northern Africa and the Middle East.
Stanford copy has handwritten notes, including "Zarife Sakir."
